dd25dbb7-ff78-4f75-8978-eecf98955d16@nin.why: The 49ers are 9-1 and lead the NFC West, while the Seahawks are 6-4 and sitting second in the division. A win would push San Francisco closer to locking up the division and a high playoff seed, while a loss would let Seattle close the gap in this head-to-head tiebreaker. It is not a must-win yet, but every division game now shapes playoff seeding.
dd25dbb7-ff78-4f75-8978-eecf98955d16@nin.know: Division games count extra because they decide tiebreakers for who wins the NFC West, which guarantees a playoff spot. Watch QB Brock Purdy, who is dealing with an ankle injury and is questionable, since backup play would change San Francisco's offense. Also watch RB Christian McCaffrey, the 49ers' workhorse runner and receiver who drives their offense when healthy.

63f1c81c-8b2d-484c-a00c-3fddacb6b4f1@ufc.why: Israel Adesanya, a two-time former middleweight champion, aims to snap a four-fight losing streak against Shara Magomedov, a hard-hitting rising contender who has called him out for years. In the co-main, Ian Machado Garry, fresh off a welterweight title loss, faces ex-Bellator champion Yaroslav Amosov in a risky test that could restart his climb back toward a title shot.
63f1c81c-8b2d-484c-a00c-3fddacb6b4f1@ufc.know: UFC rankings run from champion down to number 15 in each weight class; beating a ranked opponent usually moves a fighter closer to a title shot. A Fight Night card has no title bout, often spotlighting rising prospects. Garry recently lost to lightweight-turned-welterweight champion Islam Makhachev, while Amosov was a feared Bellator champion before joining the UFC.
